note: Submodule of datetime_flatpickr. Provides one Better Exposed Filters widget plugin, bef_flatpickr (class FlatpickrDateBef extends FilterWidgetBase, label 'Date Picker with Flatpickr'), applicable only to non-grouped Views Date filters. Selecting it is stored in the view display at display_options.exposed_form.type='bef' and exposed_form.options.bef.filter.<filter_id>.plugin_id='bef_flatpickr'. Reuses DateTimeFlatPickrWidgetTrait; exposedFormAlter() renders the exposed element via the datetime_flatpickr form element. No config/permissions/routes. Medium/hard cases build a view (dtf_bef_view) with an exposed 'created' date filter and read/set its BEF widget to bef_flatpickr.

evals.prompt: What does the datetime_flatpickr_bef submodule add, and what is the id/label of the Better Exposed Filters widget it provides?
evals.expected_output: It adds a Better Exposed Filters filter-widget plugin, bef_flatpickr (label 'Date Picker with Flatpickr'), which renders a Views exposed date filter as a flatpickr picker.

evals.prompt: For which kind of Views exposed filter can I choose the 'Date Picker with Flatpickr' (bef_flatpickr) widget, and what modules are required?
evals.expected_output: Only for exposed Views Date filters that are not grouped (isApplicable checks for a views Date handler / date_handler). It requires better_exposed_filters, datetime, and datetime_flatpickr.

evals.prompt: If I select the bef_flatpickr widget for an exposed date filter in a view, where in the view configuration is that choice stored?
evals.expected_output: In the view display's exposed_form: type is 'bef' and exposed_form.options.bef.filter.<filter_id>.plugin_id is 'bef_flatpickr' (with the flatpickr settings alongside).

evals.prompt: This site has a view with machine id 'dtf_bef_view' whose exposed 'created' date filter uses a Better Exposed Filters date widget. Inspect the view configuration and state which BEF widget plugin the 'created' filter uses.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.dtf_bef_view the default display's exposed_form.options.bef.filter.created.plugin_id is 'bef_flatpickr' (Date Picker with Flatpickr).

evals.prompt: The view 'dtf_bef_view' on this site uses Better Exposed Filters with the Flatpickr date widget. Inspect the view and state the exposed form 'type' (plugin) the default display uses.
evals.expected_output: The default display's exposed_form.type is 'bef' (Better Exposed Filters), which is required before the bef_flatpickr widget can be selected for the date filter.

evals.prompt: On this site the view 'dtf_bef_view' already uses Better Exposed Filters, and its exposed 'created' date filter is currently set to the default BEF widget. Using datetime_flatpickr_bef, change that filter's BEF widget to the Flatpickr date picker (bef_flatpickr) and apply the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.dtf_bef_view set display.default.display_options.exposed_form.options.bef.filter.created.plugin_id to 'bef_flatpickr' and save.
evals.difficulty_note: verify passes when the created filter's BEF plugin_id is bef_flatpickr.

evals.prompt: On my site the view 'dtf_bef_view2' has a date filter that already shows a Flatpickr calendar (bef_flatpickr) in its exposed filters, but the dates come out in the American Y-m-d style. I want the picker to use the day/month/year format 'd/m/Y' instead. Change that on the live view.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.dtf_bef_view2 set display.default.display_options.exposed_form.options.bef.filter.created.dateFormat to 'd/m/Y' (the bef_flatpickr widget's Flatpickr settings) and save.
evals.difficulty_note: verify passes when the created filter's bef_flatpickr dateFormat is d/m/Y.
